## Changes

## Critical
- app/results.py:8 — correctness — Reject releases when the results file is missing — When the results file is absent, `release_allowed(path)` now returns `True`: the new empty-list fallback reaches `all(...)`, which succeeds for an empty iterable. Previously, the missing file raised `FileNotFoundError`. — A release can proceed without any saved checks when its results file is missing or its path is incorrect.
